name: AutoBlockRefiller
summary: Empty hotbar slots refill automatically while you build, straight from your inventory.

AutoBlockRefiller When placing blocks empties your hotbar slot (or offhand) and more of the same block sit anywhere in your main inventory, one full stack slides into the empty slot. Snowballs, ender pearls, firework rockets and other items you use up by right-clicking refill the same way. Server side, a couple of ticks later.

Snowflakes and sleigh bells: Every refill gives a small puff of snowflakes and a bell chime that climbs a note each time. Snowball fights never stop: Snowballs always refill, even with refillItems off. Turn it off any time: /autoblockrefiller set winter false.

Triggers on right-click with a block or a usable item; checks 2 ticks later. Refills only when the used slot is actually empty (failed placements and manual swaps are respected, never overwritten). Blocks match by block; items must match exactly, so a splash potion of healing is never swapped for poison. Armour and other wearables are never refilled, so putting on a chestplate leaves your hand emp

Command: /autoblockrefiller, also /abr /autoblockrefiller: Every setting with its value. Operators click a value to change it. /autoblockrefiller toggle: Any player turns refilling off or on, just for themselves. /autoblockrefiller set <setting> <value>: Operators change a setting, with tab completion. /autoblockrefiller reset <setting>|all: Operators put settings back to their defaults.

AutoBlockRefiller sends anonymous stats (how often slots get refilled, with which blocks, and errors in its own code) to its FastStats project through Mycel. It follows Mycel's choice exactly: the one-time screen in your own game, shareStats / shareErrors in config/mycel.json on servers.

Change them in game with /autoblockrefiller, or with /mycel set autoblockrefiller <key> <value>. A config screen is available from the mod list on Forge and NeoForge.
